host.description: Host name for the application, like 'metabase.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

ldap_domain.title: User domain for LDAP login
ldap_domain.description: Name of an NS8 user domain (OpenLDAP or Active Directory) whose users can sign in to Metabase. Empty disables the LDAP login. Omitted keeps the current value.

admin_email.description: Email of the first Metabase administrator. Used only while Metabase has no account yet; an instance that already has accounts is never changed.

admin_password.description: Write-only password of the first Metabase administrator (12 to 72 characters). Kept in a 0600 file until used, never returned. Empty or missing sets no administrator.
